goal: Add a root-only staging local first-install helper for one manifest-bound normal application private-file set on a prepared pre-daemon host, without executing workloads.
live_use_requires: accepted nonsecret owner identities and numeric resource versions
authenticated publisher acceptance and external secret provenance
accepted mounted-device and pre-daemon host evidence
separate reviewed helper-installation and local delivery authorization
